page.content:
Cobra scientist who builds Serpentor and the Brain-wave Scanner.

How Dr. Mindbender connects

  • Character: Serpentor — Dr. Mindbender genetically builds Serpentor from the DNA of conquerors.
  • Faction: Cobra — Dr. Mindbender is Cobra's chief scientist.

What is Dr. Mindbender?

Dr. Mindbender is Cobra's mad dentist-turned-scientist, creator of Serpentor and of the mind-control gear that the Baroness and Cobra Commander keep turning on prisoners.

Key threads lead to Serpentor and Cobra.
